role: Static GL state helpers for the fixed-function lighting used on items: the standard two-light setup (ambient 0.4, diffuse 0.6 from directions (0.2, 1, -0.7) and (-0.2, 1, 0.7)) and the GUI variant that rotates the lights with -30 yaw and 165 pitch.
scope_reason: The light directions and ambient/diffuse constants change the pixels of every lit item and hand quad, so the C renderer had to reproduce them.

members.name: disableStandardItemLighting
members.note: GL enable/disable plumbing; the native rasterizers carry per-pass state instead of GL toggles

members.name: enableStandardItemLighting
members.note: the two light positions go to eye space under the current modelview, Mesa normalizes them; the ambient 0.4 + diffuse 0.6 factor is evaluated in raster_hand.c lit and raster_entities.c compute_diffuse

members.name: setColorBuffer
members.note: light parameter packing; the constants land in set_lights and compute_diffuse

members.name: enableGUIStandardItemLighting
members.note: the rotated light positions after -30 yaw and 165 pitch are hardcoded in the HUD item renderer's comment and constants

notes: The eye-space light transform and the eye_normal rescale live in raster_hand.c (set_lights, eye_normal); the entity path folds the same constants into compute_diffuse in raster_entities.c. Verified the constants at raster_hand.c:57-60, raster_entities.c:114-124 and raster_hud.c:714-716. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): GL plumbing: GL is the numerical oracle, not emitted (SPEC); atlases and meshes are consumed as data. Formerly listed as missing: disableStandardItemLighting: the GL toggle has no native counterpart because the rasterizers carry per-pass state; behaviour is equivalent.
